username.title: RP Data username
username.description: Your RP Data Professional (rpp.corelogic.com.au) account username/email. The actor logs in as you — only scrape data your subscription entitles you to access.

password.title: RP Data password
password.description: Your RP Data Professional account password. Stored encrypted by Apify.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Addresses or suburbs to search, one per item. Full addresses (e.g. "10 Smith St, Richmond VIC 3121") resolve to a single property. Suburb queries (e.g. "Richmond VIC 3121") list properties from the suburb search results up to Max results per query.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: For suburb-level queries, the maximum number of properties to scrape from the result list. Full-address queries always return a single property.

includeSalesHistory.title: Include sales history
includeSalesHistory.description: Extract the property's 'For Sale' / sold history timeline where available.

includeRentalHistory.title: Include rental history
includeRentalHistory.description: Extract the property's rental listing history where available.

captureApiResponses.title: Capture raw API responses
captureApiResponses.description: Also store the raw JSON responses RP Data's frontend fetches for each property (attributes, valuations, history). More complete than DOM scraping and resilient to UI redesigns; increases dataset item size.

reuseSession.title: Reuse login session between runs
reuseSession.description: Persist cookies to the key-value store and reuse them on the next run so the actor doesn't log in every time. Reduces the chance of triggering CoreLogic's concurrent-session/anomaly detection.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Australian residential proxies are strongly recommended — CoreLogic geo-blocks and rate-limits foreign datacenter IPs.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Navigation timeout (seconds)
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for pages/searches before failing a request.

debugScreenshots.title: Save debug screenshots
debugScreenshots.description: On any failure, save a screenshot and HTML snapshot to the key-value store to help diagnose selector/login issues.
